sloka: तामार्याम् स्वयमेवेह राजाऽनुग्रहणेन वा ।सौमित्रे भर कौसल्या मुक्तमर्थमिमम् चर ॥२-३१-१५॥
transliteration: tāmāryām svayameveha rājā'nugrahaṇena vā ।saumitre bhara kausalyā muktamarthamimam cara ॥2-31-15॥

translations.english: Either by yourself or by seeking the favour of the king, O son of Sumitra, lend support to venerable Kausalya. This is the objective you must accomplish.
